question: ¿Qué productos tienen existencias totales (suma de todos los almacenes) por debajo de su punto de reorden?
sql: SELECT p.sku FROM products p JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand) AS total FROM stock GROUP BY sku) t ON t.sku = p.sku WHERE t.total < p.reorder_point

question: Which products have total on-hand stock (summed across all warehouses) below their reorder point?
sql: SELECT p.sku FROM products p JOIN (SELECT sku, SUM(on_hand) AS total FROM stock GROUP BY sku) t ON t.sku = p.sku WHERE t.total < p.reorder_point

question: ¿Qué productos críticos surtidos por un proveedor de Alemania están por debajo de su punto de reorden en al menos un almacén?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN stock st ON st.sku = p.sku WHERE p.critical AND s.country = 'DE' AND st.on_hand < p.reorder_point

question: Which critical products supplied by a German supplier are below their reorder point in at least one warehouse?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.sku FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id JOIN stock st ON st.sku = p.sku WHERE p.critical AND s.country = 'DE' AND st.on_hand < p.reorder_point

question: ¿Qué categoría vendió más unidades en abril de 2026? Desempata por nombre de categoría en orden ascendente.
sql: SELECT p.category FROM sales_daily d JOIN products p ON p.sku = d.sku WHERE d.day >= '2026-04-01' AND d.day < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(d.units) DESC, p.category LIMIT 1

question: Which category sold the most units in April 2026? Break ties by category name ascending.
sql: SELECT p.category FROM sales_daily d JOIN products p ON p.sku = d.sku WHERE d.day >= '2026-04-01' AND d.day < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(d.units) DESC, p.category LIMIT 1

question: Considerando solo los días con registro de venta, ¿qué SKU tuvo el mayor promedio diario de unidades en el segundo trimestre de 2026 (abril a junio)? Desempata por SKU en orden ascendente.
sql: SELECT d.sku FROM sales_daily d WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY d.sku ORDER BY AVG(d.units) DESC, d.sku LIMIT 1

question: Considering only days that have a sales record, which SKU had the highest average daily units in Q2 2026 (April to June)? Break ties by SKU ascending.
sql: SELECT d.sku FROM sales_daily d WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY d.sku ORDER BY AVG(d.units) DESC, d.sku LIMIT 1

question: ¿En cuántos meses calendario las unidades vendidas totales fueron mayores que en el mes anterior? No cuentes el primer mes de los datos.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', day) AS mes, SUM(units) AS total FROM sales_daily GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT mes, total, LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS previo FROM m) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c WHERE previo IS NOT NULL AND total > previo

question: In how many calendar months were total units sold higher than in the previous month? Do not count the first month in the data.
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', day) AS mes, SUM(units) AS total FROM sales_daily GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT mes, total, LAG(total) OVER (ORDER BY mes) AS previo FROM m) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c WHERE previo IS NOT NULL AND total > previo

question: ¿Qué proveedor tiene la mayor cantidad de productos críticos? Desempata por nombre de proveedor en orden ascendente.
sql: SELECT s.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.critical GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.name LIMIT 1

question: Which supplier has the largest number of critical products? Break ties by supplier name ascending.
sql: SELECT s.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE p.critical GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.name LIMIT 1

question: ¿Cuántos productos vendieron al menos una unidad entre el 2026-09-01 y el 2026-09-26 y no tienen registro de existencias en el almacén de Monterrey?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.sku) FROM sales_daily d WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-26' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.sku = d.sku AND w.city = 'Monterrey')

question: How many products sold at least one unit between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-26 and have no stock record at the Monterrey warehouse?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.sku) FROM sales_daily d WHERE d.day BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-26' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.sku = d.sku AND w.city = 'Monterrey')

question: ¿Cuál es la mediana del costo unitario de los productos de la categoría Hidraulico? Da el valor exacto, sin redondear.
sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY unit_cost) FROM products WHERE category = 'Hidraulico'

question: What is the median unit cost of products in the Hidraulico category? Give the exact value, without rounding.
sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY unit_cost) FROM products WHERE category = 'Hidraulico'

question: ¿Cuál es el costo unitario promedio de los productos cuyo proveedor tiene un tiempo de entrega mayor a 30 días? Da el valor exacto, sin redondear.
sql: SELECT AVG(p.unit_cost) FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE s.lead_time_days > 30

question: What is the average unit cost of products whose supplier has a lead time greater than 30 days? Give the exact value, without rounding.
sql: SELECT AVG(p.unit_cost) FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id WHERE s.lead_time_days > 30

question: ¿Cuántos SKU vendieron más de 500 unidades en total entre el 2026-08-28 y el 2026-09-26?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM sales_daily WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-08-28' AND '2026-09-26' GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(units) > 500) x

question: How many SKUs sold more than 500 units in total between 2026-08-28 and 2026-09-26?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM sales_daily WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-08-28' AND '2026-09-26' GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(units) > 500) x

question: ¿Qué almacén tiene el mayor valor de inventario a costo (suma de unidades en existencia por costo unitario)?
sql: SELECT w.name FROM stock s JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.name ORDER BY SUM(s.on_hand * p.unit_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which warehouse has the largest inventory value at cost (sum of on-hand units times unit cost)?
sql: SELECT w.name FROM stock s JOIN products p ON p.sku = s.sku JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.name ORDER BY SUM(s.on_hand * p.unit_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

question: ¿Qué SKU tienen registro de existencias en los tres almacenes?
sql: SELECT sku FROM stock GROUP BY sku HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_id) = 3

question: Which SKUs have a stock record in all three warehouses?

question: Para cada almacén, ¿qué SKU tiene la mayor cantidad en existencia? Desempata por SKU en orden ascendente.
sql: SELECT w.name, s.sku FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, sku, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY on_hand DESC, sku) AS rn FROM stock) s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.rn = 1

question: For each warehouse, which SKU has the largest on-hand quantity? Break ties by SKU ascending.
sql: SELECT w.name, s.sku FROM (SELECT warehouse_id, sku, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY on_hand DESC, sku) AS rn FROM stock) s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id WHERE s.rn = 1

question: ¿Qué tres categorías son surtidas por la mayor cantidad de proveedores distintos? Desempata por nombre de categoría en orden ascendente.
sql: SELECT p.category FROM products p WHERE p.supplier_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) DESC, p.category LIMIT 3

question: Which three categories are supplied by the largest number of distinct suppliers? Break ties by category name ascending.
sql: SELECT p.category FROM products p WHERE p.supplier_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.supplier_id) DESC, p.category LIMIT 3

question: ¿Cuántas unidades se vendieron en fin de semana (sábado y domingo) entre el 2026-04-01 y el 2026-09-26?
sql: SELECT SUM(units) FROM sales_daily WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM day) IN (6, 7) AND day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-26'

question: How many units were sold on weekends (Saturday and Sunday) between 2026-04-01 and 2026-09-26?
sql: SELECT SUM(units) FROM sales_daily WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM day) IN (6, 7) AND day BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-09-26'

question: ¿Qué día de la semana ISO (1 = lunes, 7 = domingo) tiene el mayor promedio de unidades totales vendidas por día? Desempata por el número de día más bajo.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM t.day)::int FROM (SELECT day, SUM(units) AS u FROM sales_daily GROUP BY day) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(t.u) DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

question: Which ISO weekday (1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday) has the highest average of total daily units sold? Break ties by the lower weekday number.
sql: SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM t.day)::int FROM (SELECT day, SUM(units) AS u FROM sales_daily GROUP BY day) t GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(t.u) DESC, 1 LIMIT 1

question: ¿Qué productos tienen un costo unitario mayor al promedio de costo unitario de su propia categoría?

question: Which products have a unit cost above the average unit cost of their own category?
